edit.description: execution (inline or forked to an agent), preloading agents, enforcement attachments
fork, preload, user-only refusal, clause and hook attachments

summary: The playbook gains its execution axis (inline or forked to an agent), the agents that preload it (refused for a user-only playbook), and enforcement attachments as a clause or a hook, never prose
acceptance: a forked playbook emits context: fork with its agent; a preloading agent lists its skill; a user-only playbook with a preloading agent throws; an attached clause or hook emits as its own member; pnpm --dir sdk test green
notes: SDK-only behavior: the SDK gate holds it. skills docs (2026-11-26): disable-model-invocation also prevents preloading into subagents, the fact behind the refusal; cite it at the throw.
